plan.target: Incorrect Cache-Block Management Operation Decode for cbo.inval with CBIE=01 (src/ieu/controller.sv and src/cache/cachefsm.sv)
plan.rationale:
In `src/ieu/controller.sv` lines 391-395, cache-block management operation decode assigns `cbo.clean` and `cbo.flush` operation codes with an internal bit-position mismatch that causes `cbo.inval` under `CBIE == 2'b01` to execute as `cbo.clean` (clean without invalidating) rather than `cbo.flush` (clean and invalidate).

According to the RISC-V Capacity and Cache-Block Management (Zicbom) Specification (Section 2, 'Cache-Block Management Instructions') and the RISC-V Privileged Architecture (v20211203, Section 3.1.12, 'Machine Environment Configuration Registers'):
When `envcfg.CBIE == 2'b01`, execution of a `cbo.inval` instruction in a less-privileged mode (e.g. S-mode or U-mode) MUST perform a flush operation, exactly like `cbo.flush`. A flush operation writes back dirty cache lines to memory and unconditionally invalidates the cache block (clearing the valid bit in the cache).

In `src/ieu/controller.sv`:
- Line 392: `CMOpD[2] = (InstrD[31:20] == 12'd2); // cbo.clean` (Note: funct12 12'd2 is actually `cbo.flush`)
- Line 393: `CMOpD[1] = (InstrD[31:20] == 12'd1) | ((InstrD[31:20] == 12'd0) & (ENVCFG_CBE[1:0] == 2'b01)); // cbo.flush` (Note: funct12 12'd1 is actually `cbo.clean`)
- Line 394: `CMOpD[0] = (InstrD[31:20] == 12'd0) & (ENVCFG_CBE[1:0] == 2'b11); // cbo.inval`

In `src/cache/cachefsm.sv` lines 159-161:
```systemverilog
assign ClearValid = (CurrState == STATE_ACCESS & (CMOpM[0] | (CMOpM[2] & ~HitLineDirty))) |
                    (CurrState == STATE_WRITEBACK & CMOpM[2] & CacheBusAck);
```
In `cachefsm.sv`, cache line invalidation (`ClearValid`) is controlled strictly by `CMOpM[0]` (`cbo.inval`) and `CMOpM[2]` (`cbo.flush`). `CMOpM[1]` (`cbo.clean`) only triggers writeback of dirty data (`CMOWriteback`) and never asserts `ClearValid`.

Because `controller.sv` line 393 mistakenly ORs `((InstrD[31:20] == 12'd0) & (ENVCFG_CBE[1:0] == 2'b01))` into `CMOpD[1]` instead of `CMOpD[2]`, executing `cbo.inval` when `CBIE == 2'b01` asserts `CMOpM[1]` and leaves `CMOpM[2] = 0`. As a result, `ClearValid` is never asserted; the cache block is written back if dirty but remains valid (`Valid = 1`) in the D-cache. The instruction performs a clean operation instead of the architecturally mandated flush operation.

This bug was confirmed live in simulation using `rv64gc_testbench`: a positive control test using `cbo.flush` correctly clears the valid bit (causing a subsequent load to miss in D-cache, `hpmcounter14` diff = 1), whereas `cbo.inval` under `CBIE = 01` fails to clear the valid bit (the subsequent load hits in D-cache, `hpmcounter14` diff = 0), triggering an explicit selfcheck failure in the testbench.
plan.tester_prompt:
Investigate and reproduce the functional bug in Wally's cache-block management operation decode logic where `cbo.inval` under `CBIE == 2'b01` fails to invalidate the cache line in the data cache (`src/ieu/controller.sv` lines 391-395 and `src/cache/cachefsm.sv` lines 159-161).

1. Target Configuration:
   - Configuration: `rv64gc` (supported default configuration with `P.DCACHE_SUPPORTED = 1` and `P.ZICBOM_SUPPORTED = 1`).
   - Build command: `make -C sim/verilator WALLYCONF=rv64gc TESTBENCH=testbench`.

2. Relevant RTL Files and Signals:
   - `src/ieu/controller.sv` lines 391-395: `CMOpD` generation from `InstrD[31:20]` and `ENVCFG_CBE[1:0]`.
   - `src/cache/cachefsm.sv` lines 99, 159-161, 172: `ClearValid`, `CMOWriteback`, `CMOpM`.
   - `src/privileged/csrc.sv` line 105: `CounterEvent[14] = DCacheMiss`, countable via `hpmcounter14`.

3. Hypothesized Failure:
   - Under `menvcfg.CBIE == 2'b01`, `cbo.inval` is decoded into `CMOpD[1]` (`cbo.clean`) rather than `CMOpD[2]` (`cbo.flush`).
   - `src/cache/cachefsm.sv` only asserts `ClearValid` for `CMOpM[0]` and `CMOpM[2]`.
   - Consequently, executing `cbo.inval` in S-mode when `CBIE == 2'b01` leaves the target cache line valid in the D-cache (`Valid = 1`), violating the RISC-V Zicbom specification which mandates that `cbo.inval` with `CBIE == 01` perform a flush operation identical to `cbo.flush`.

4. Test Suite Construction (Assembly / Self-checking Test):
   Build two standalone assembly test programs (using linker script `tests/riscof/spike/env/link.ld` and gcc flags `-march=rv64gc_zicbom -mabi=lp64d -nostdlib -nostartfiles`):
   - Negative / Bug Test (`test_cbo_cbie.S`):
     a. In M-mode, initialize PMP (`pmpaddr0 = -1`, `pmpcfg0 = 0x1f`) to allow full S-mode access.
     b. In M-mode, set `mcounteren = -1` and `scounteren = -1` to allow S-mode access to hardware performance counters.
     c. In M-mode, set `menvcfg = 0xD0` (setting `CBIE = 2'b01` at bits [5:4], `CBCFE = 1` at bit 6, and `CBZE = 1` at bit 7).
     d. Transition to S-mode using `mret` (with `mstatus.MPP = 1`).
     e. In S-mode, perform a 64-bit load (`ld t0, 0(a0)`) from a 64-byte aligned data block to warm up the D-cache and ensure the line is valid.
     f. Execute `cbo.inval 0(a0)` (which under `CBIE = 01` must invalidate the line).
     g. Read `hpmcounter14` (which counts `DCacheMiss`) into register `s0`.
     h. Perform a second load (`ld t1, 0(a0)`) from the same data block.
     i. Read `hpmcounter14` into register `s1`.
     j. Compute `diff = s1 - s0`.
     k. Check `diff`: if the line was properly invalidated, the second load must miss in D-cache (`diff >= 1`). If the line remained valid (Wally bug), the load hits in D-cache (`diff == 0`).
     l. Store results into `selfcheck_record` (offset 0: status = 1 for pass, 2 for failure; offset 24: expected = 1; offset 32: actual = diff). If `diff == 0`, exit with `status = 2`.
   - Positive Control Test (`test_cbo_flush_control.S`):
     Identical to the test above, but using `cbo.flush 0(a0)` in step (f). In Wally, `cbo.flush` correctly asserts `CMOpM[2]` and clears the valid bit, so the second load misses (`diff == 1`), cleanly producing `status = 1` and passing.

5. Verification Method & Success/Failure Criteria:
   - DUT execution: Run `Vtestbench +ElfFile=<path_to_elf>`.
   - On the positive control (`cbo.flush`), the test outputs `... succeeded. Brilliant!!!` and Verilator exits 0.
   - On the bug reproducer (`cbo.inval` with `CBIE=01`), `CheckSelfCheck` in `testbench/testbench.sv` detects `actual = 0` vs `expected = 1`, logs `Error on test ... sim (D$) 0000000000000000 signature = 0000000000000001`, and aborts via `$stop` (terminating with exit code 134).
   - Reproducer script (`reproducer.sh`) must:
     - Rebuild `rv64gc_testbench` against `$WALLY/src`.
     - Run the reproducer binary against `Vtestbench`.
     - Exit 0 if DUT behavior is correct, exit 1 ONLY if the functional mismatch is reproduced (exit code 134 / selfcheck failure), and exit 2 for build/tooling errors.

6. Critical Workspace & File Hygiene Rules:
   - Write test source files into `$test_dir/tests/` ONCE before running `reproducer.sh`.
   - `reproducer.sh` must write all intermediate compiler artifacts, binaries, and logs strictly into `$test_dir/build/` and `$test_dir/logs/`.
   - Never modify or create files in `$test_dir` outside `build/` and `logs/` during `reproducer.sh`, to ensure `loop.py` hash checks pass.
plan.knowledge:
1. Source Files & Logic Analyzed:
   - `src/ieu/controller.sv` lines 391-395: Cache-block management operation decode:
     `CMOpD[3] = (InstrD[31:20] == 12'd4); // cbo.zero`
     `CMOpD[2] = (InstrD[31:20] == 12'd2); // cbo.clean` (funct12 12'd2 is cbo.flush!)
     `CMOpD[1] = (InstrD[31:20] == 12'd1) | ((InstrD[31:20] == 12'd0) & (ENVCFG_CBE[1:0] == 2'b01)); // cbo.flush` (funct12 12'd1 is cbo.clean!)
     `CMOpD[0] = (InstrD[31:20] == 12'd0) & (ENVCFG_CBE[1:0] == 2'b11); // cbo.inval`
     The author swapped the semantic naming comments of `CMOpD[1]` and `CMOpD[2]`, and erroneously mapped the `CBIE == 2'b01` condition to `CMOpD[1]` (clean) instead of `CMOpD[2]` (flush).
   - `src/cache/cachefsm.sv` lines 159-161: `ClearValid = (CurrState == STATE_ACCESS & (CMOpM[0] | (CMOpM[2] & ~HitLineDirty))) | (CurrState == STATE_WRITEBACK & CMOpM[2] & CacheBusAck);`. `ClearValid` strictly checks `CMOpM[0]` and `CMOpM[2]`. `CMOpM[1]` performs writeback if dirty (`CMOWriteback`) and clears dirty (`ClearDirty`), but never asserts `ClearValid`.
   - `src/privileged/csrc.sv` lines 105, 171-177: `CounterEvent[14] = DCacheMiss`, counting data cache misses via `hpmcounter14`. Both `mcounteren` and `scounteren` must be enabled to allow S-mode access to `hpmcounter14`.
   - `testbench/testbench.sv` lines 480-488, 1075-1115: `CheckSelfCheck` reads `selfcheck_record` (offsets 0: status, 8: index, 16: adr, 24: expected, 32: actual). Setting `status = 2` on mismatch triggers `$stop` (terminating Verilator with exit code 134).
   - `src/mmu/pmpchecker.sv` lines 87-89: `PMPCBOMAccessFault` checks `~MatchingR` for `|CMOpM[2:0]`, which is compliant since all CMO operations require read permission.
   - `src/ieu/controller.sv` line 309: `assign SFenceVmaD = PrivilegedD & (InstrD[31:25] == 7'b0001001);` only checks `7'b0001001` (`sfence.vma`), omitting Svinval instructions (`sinval.vma`, `sfence.w.inval`, `sfence.inval.ir`).
   - `src/privileged/csrs.sv` lines 158-160: Confirmed previous iteration's fix for `satp` (removal of `P.VIRTMEM_SUPPORTED &`).

2. Specification References:
   - RISC-V Capacity and Cache-Block Management (Zicbom) Specification (Version 1.0.4):
     - Section 2 ('Cache-Block Management Instructions'): `cbo.inval` (funct12 = 0x000), `cbo.clean` (funct12 = 0x001), `cbo.flush` (funct12 = 0x002).
     - Section 2: 'The envcfg.CBIE field controls the behavior of CBO.INVAL in less-privileged modes... When CBIE = 01b: Execution of a CBO.INVAL instruction performs a flush operation, the same as CBO.FLUSH.'
     - Section 1.1 / Section 2: 'A flush operation consists of a clean operation followed by an invalidate operation. It writes back dirty cache block to memory if dirty, and invalidates the cache block in all levels of the cache hierarchy.'
   - RISC-V Instruction Set Manual, Volume II: Privileged Architecture (v20211203):
     - Section 3.1.12 ('Machine Environment Configuration Registers'): `menvcfg.CBIE` bits [5:4] define Cache-Block Invalidate Enable.
   - Local `isa_docs` disclosure: Local ISA documentation was unavailable in the worktree (`"isa_docs": ""`). Normative rules were verified directly against official RISC-V specifications.

3. Toolchain & Environment Insights:
   - Verilator: Verilator 5.036 installed at `/opt/riscv/bin/verilator`. `rv64gc_testbench` builds via `make -C sim/verilator WALLYCONF=rv64gc TESTBENCH=testbench`.
   - Spike: Installed at `/opt/riscv/bin/spike`. When testing with performance counters, pass `--isa=rv64gc_zicbom_zihpm`.
   - Critical loop.py hygiene: `loop.py` hashes all files in `$test_dir` outside `build/` and `logs/`. Any file modifications inside `$test_dir` or `$test_dir/tests` during `reproducer.sh` will cause `RuntimeError('Original reproducer inputs changed during bug review')`. Tests must be written once before running the reproducer script, and all artifacts written strictly to `$test_dir/build/` and `$test_dir/logs/`.
